physics_verdict: VACANCY is the robust conductivity lever: modelc (Li5.4, vacancy) sigma300 ~5x comp1 (survives all uncertainty). Br isovalent Cl->Br (comp2, Li6 no-vacancy) shows NO clear boost: central sigma300 0.51x comp1 (slightly worse), but 800K seed scatter makes Ea 0.276+/-0.033 -> sigma300 ratio 0.14-1.82x = INCONCLUSIVE. In the measured 600-1000K range comp2 D > comp1 at every T, but the steeper/uncertain Ea makes the 300K extrapolation unreliable. Experimental Br benefit (Kraft 2018) is driven by anion site disorder (Br/S2- mixing) NOT sampled by our single champion config.
recommendation: For a paper-grade Br-vs-Cl sigma claim: reseed 800K (s5/s6) to tighten Ea, and run comp1 multi-seed (currently single). Consider anion-disorder ensemble to capture the experimental Br mechanism.
